messages.content: I’ll sell into the forecast evening peaks, keep charging flexible as the wind outlook updates, and limit reserve awards to what the battery can support.

The first morning cycle has settled. The battery is full for the evening, and both DAM submissions are in. This tier allows energy trading only, so no reserve awards were placed. I’ll continue adjusting the physical schedule as forecasts and RT prices update.
